1. Take the luma.
2. Smooth it with the ISEF, a forward and a backward recursion along each row and each column.
3. Subtract the luma from the smoothed image, and mark the positive pixels.
4. Take the marked pixels that have an unmarked 4-neighbor as zero crossings.
5. Measure the gradient of the smoothed image at the zero crossings.
6. Keep the edges with hysteresis between the low and the high threshold.
